top_issues.issue: Fixed navigation widths squeeze the task pane and truncate identity information.
top_issues.evidence: At 760 pixels, the rail and list end at x=296, leaving 464 pixels before content padding. Calls truncates Katherine, Ada, Grace, Dorothy, and Margaret; channel composer placeholder wraps.
top_issues.fix: Below 900 points, reduce the list to 200 points and offer a collapsible list with a labeled Back control. Preserve full person names in the selected header; use 16-point task-pane padding.

top_issues.issue: The scrollbar thumb and track do not meet the 3:1 non-text contrast threshold.
top_issues.evidence: Original PNG x=890: light y=300 #eeeef0 and y=500 #f6f6f7 yield 1.07:1; dark y=300 #2c2d33 and y=500 #17181b yield 1.29:1. The thumb/track boundary is difficult to identify.
top_issues.fix: Use an 8-point thumb, #737780 against #eeeef0 in light mode and #9c9ea8 against #17181b in dark mode. Keep the track visible and provide 8 points of separation from labels.

top_issues.issue: Helper and metadata text is too small for comfortable desktop reading, even though sampled colors pass contrast.
top_issues.evidence: Composer help occupies approximately 11-pixel line height near y=780 at 1280x800; it wraps into two lines in narrow views. Settings helper paragraphs and onboarding footers use similarly small glyphs. #62656d on white measures 5.83:1; #9c9ea8 on #25262b measures 5.66:1.
top_issues.fix: Use 12-point metadata and 13-point helper text with 18-point line spacing. Reduce persistent composer help to Enter to send and Shift+Enter for a new line; move formatting syntax behind a help control.

top_issues.issue: Reading and composing use different horizontal constraints on wide windows.
top_issues.evidence: At 1920x1080, the hovered message ends near x=1308 while the composer extends to approximately x=1904. Much of the right side stays empty above the input.
top_issues.fix: Place messages and composer in the same 960-point maximum-width column with matching 16-point insets. Align the send action with the reading column's right edge.

top_issues.issue: The long-draft viewport cuts through the first visible line and packs many lines tightly against its edges.
top_issues.evidence: At the composer's top edge around y=548, the visible column_108 line is clipped through its glyphs. Subsequent lines have about 17 pixels of vertical advance.
top_issues.fix: Use 14-point draft text on a 20-point line height, 12-point internal padding, and an 8-point visible scrollbar. Keep the caret line fully visible and use a subtle top scroll shadow outside the text ink.

top_issues.issue: Attachment thumbnails crop away enough content to make pending-image verification difficult.
top_issues.evidence: The pending tiles around x=393..840 and y=619..713 show a strip cropped horizontally and another image cropped vertically. Only image fragments and remove controls identify the attachments.
top_issues.fix: Contain each image in a 144 by 96-point neutral tile rather than cropping. Add a 12-point filename or dimensions below it and a clearly accessible preview action; keep remove buttons at least 24 by 24 points.

top_issues.issue: Search results visually outweigh the selected recipient, making the pending chat target less obvious.
top_issues.evidence: The small Grace Hopper chip near y=199 competes with a full-width highlighted Barbara Liskov result near y=268. The primary button and explanatory footnote share a crowded baseline near y=427.
top_issues.fix: Add a persistent 12-point To label and a separate selected-recipient row with 36-point chips. Label the search field Find another person. Put the existing-chat explanation below the button with an 8-point gap at 12 points.

top_issues.issue: The calls landing page devotes most of its task area to explanation instead of immediate actions.
top_issues.evidence: At 760x640 the explanation occupies roughly y=275..460, with wrapped prose and capability statements; the actual join card occupies roughly y=108..217. Contact names truncate beside paired icons.
top_issues.fix: Keep Join a meeting first, follow with one 13-point sentence explaining browser handoff, and put capability details in the existing disclosure. Use 40-point contact rows with full names and reveal a labeled Call action for the selected person.

top_issues.issue: The call panel repeats the meeting identity across two stacked headers.
top_issues.evidence: Meeting identity appears in the top status bar and again in the conversation header. In the 380-pixel screen the second title becomes Design review:... while the stack occupies approximately the first 148 pixels.
top_issues.fix: Combine status and conversation identity into one header, with a 15-point meeting title and 12-point live status. Place Join on phone, Restore, and Close bar in a 32-point action row below, targeting an 88-point total header.

top_issues.issue: Secondary actions have faint outlines and often look like ordinary labels.
top_issues.evidence: In signin, secondary button border #303137 against dialog #25262b measures only 1.17:1; light equivalents #dfdfe3 on white measure 1.33:1. Text remains readable, so these ratios alone do not prove a text or universal button WCAG failure.
top_issues.fix: Give outlined secondary actions a 1-point #6e7179 border in dark mode and #8a8d95 in light mode, with at least 32-point height and 12-point horizontal padding. Preserve stronger fill for the primary action.

top_issues.issue: The preview dialog is much taller than its panoramic content needs.
top_issues.evidence: The image is labeled 3072 by 256, but the dialog occupies almost the full 800-pixel window height. The visible strip sits amid several hundred pixels of unused vertical canvas.
top_issues.fix: Adapt the dialog's initial height to the fitted image plus a 72-point toolbar and padding, with a 320-point minimum. Keep an explicit Maximize action for inspection.

top_issues.issue: The permission title communicates an extra step rather than the capability being granted.
top_issues.evidence: One more permission is the largest text; Starting new chats is a smaller line, while Graph's Chat.Create scope and administrator explanation sit in a compact paragraph.
top_issues.fix: Use Allow Wren to start chats as the 20-point title, explain the browser step in 13-point text with 18-point line spacing, and place the technical scope in a separate 12-point detail row.

top_issues.issue: Long utility lists lack explicit subgroup headings.
top_issues.evidence: The account menu contains two accounts followed by presence choices and application actions. Shortcuts presents about fifteen commands in one continuous list; account-menu separators help, but no group labels identify their meaning.
top_issues.fix: Add 12-point Accounts and Presence labels to the account menu and Navigation, Messaging, and Application labels to shortcuts. Use 12-point space before each group and keep command rows at least 28 points tall.
